killedBy: the developer modules load when the pane opens (issue #1014) an armed action lapses when another pane opens over it, so the press on return arms again
why: Issue #1014. Opening a layer stops disarming, so a developer action armed in Developer Tools stays armed while Configuration is open over it. Read at that moment: every Back re-enters its origin through `setState`, which disarms on its own, so a case that read the arm only after coming back could not see this -- measured, it survived that shape.
